name: Ephemeris Source Retriever
description: Portable C++ ephemeris discovery and raw source descriptor processing (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON between modules, no host imports). $SRG (data source registry) carries the registry, retrieval settings, discovery queues and single jobs; HttpRequest/HttpResponse carry the fetches; $NCD and $CAT the descriptors and declared coverage. Network replies are explicit HttpResponse frames; scheduled acquisition uses the companion host adapter.

sequentialJustification.detail: Bounded request planning, explicit listing-response discovery and raw NCD descriptor transformation. The core has no host imports and spawns no threads.

methods.description: The compiled provider registry (sources.json, mirrored from starlink_downloader) as one $SRG with PROVIDERS and the upstream repository, revision and path.

outputPorts.description: One size-prefixed $SRG: PROVIDERS (SOURCE_ID, NAME, OPERATOR, FORMAT, ORIGINS, REFRESH_INTERVAL_S, CREDENTIALED) and UPSTREAM_REPOSITORY / UPSTREAM_REVISION / REGISTRY_PATH.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One size-prefixed $SRG: PROVIDERS (SOURCE_ID, NAME, OPERATOR, FORMAT, ORIGINS, REFRESH_INTERVAL_S, CREDENTIALED) and UPSTREAM_REPOSITORY / UPSTREAM_REVISION / REGISTRY_PATH.

methods.description: Retrieval settings -> the first-round listing requests of the provider (GET HttpRequests with the settings' timeout and byte budget, CONTEXT the settings $SRG). A direct-URL provider needs none.

inputPorts.description: One size-prefixed $SRG whose SETTINGS name the provider (SOURCE_ID) and the limits: EPOCH_MS (0 = now), TIMEOUT_MS, MAX_BYTES, MAX_RUNTIME_MS; a zero field takes the default.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One size-prefixed $SRG whose SETTINGS name the provider (SOURCE_ID) and the limits: EPOCH_MS (0 = now), TIMEOUT_MS, MAX_BYTES, MAX_RUNTIME_MS; a zero field takes the default.

outputPorts.description: One GET HttpRequest (HREQ) per listing URL, CONTEXT the settings $SRG.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One GET HttpRequest (HREQ) per listing URL, CONTEXT the settings $SRG.

methods.description: Retrieval settings plus the listings' HttpResponses (matched by URL; a 404 GPS-week listing permits previous-week fallback) -> the discovery queue as one $SRG with RESOURCES, and one GET HttpRequest per resource whose CONTEXT is its job ($SRG with that one resource).

inputPorts.description: One size-prefixed $SRG whose SETTINGS name the provider (SOURCE_ID) and the limits: EPOCH_MS (0 = now), TIMEOUT_MS, MAX_BYTES, MAX_RUNTIME_MS; a zero field takes the default.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One size-prefixed $SRG whose SETTINGS name the provider (SOURCE_ID) and the limits: EPOCH_MS (0 = now), TIMEOUT_MS, MAX_BYTES, MAX_RUNTIME_MS; a zero field takes the default.

inputPorts.description: The HttpResponses (HRSP) of the planned listing requests, one per URL; none for a direct-URL provider.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The HttpResponses (HRSP) of the planned listing requests, one per URL; none for a direct-URL provider.

outputPorts.description: One size-prefixed $SRG: RESOURCES (SOURCE_ID, RESOURCE_ID, URL, FORMAT, DISCOVERED_AT_MS) in retrieval order, GENERATED_AT_MS the discovery epoch.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One size-prefixed $SRG: RESOURCES (SOURCE_ID, RESOURCE_ID, URL, FORMAT, DISCOVERED_AT_MS) in retrieval order, GENERATED_AT_MS the discovery epoch.

outputPorts.description: One GET HttpRequest (HREQ) per resource, CONTEXT its job: a size-prefixed $SRG with that one resource.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One GET HttpRequest (HREQ) per resource, CONTEXT its job: a size-prefixed $SRG with that one resource.

methods.description: A resource's HttpResponse (job in CONTEXT, the raw file as BODY) and the content store's receipt -> one canonical size-prefixed $NCD (format, byte length, SHA-256, source CID). The URL must lie in the provider's origins.

inputPorts.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) of one resource: STATUS 200 with BODY the raw file verbatim, CONTEXT the job - a size-prefixed $SRG with exactly one RESOURCES entry (as discover_sources puts it in the request).

acceptedTypeSets.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) of one resource: STATUS 200 with BODY the raw file verbatim, CONTEXT the job - a size-prefixed $SRG with exactly one RESOURCES entry (as discover_sources puts it in the request).

inputPorts.description: One size-prefixed $SRG with exactly one RECEIPTS entry: the CID the content store gave the raw bytes.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One size-prefixed $SRG with exactly one RECEIPTS entry: the CID the content store gave the raw bytes.

methods.description: A resource's HttpResponse (job in CONTEXT naming its FORMAT, the raw file as BODY) -> the international designators declared in complete CCSDS OEM metadata or in checksummed TLE pairs, as size-prefixed $CAT records; nothing for other formats.

inputPorts.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) of one resource: STATUS 200 with BODY the raw file verbatim, CONTEXT the job - a size-prefixed $SRG with exactly one RESOURCES entry (as discover_sources puts it in the request).

acceptedTypeSets.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) of one resource: STATUS 200 with BODY the raw file verbatim, CONTEXT the job - a size-prefixed $SRG with exactly one RESOURCES entry (as discover_sources puts it in the request).
